# Beyond the Speaking Valve
:::

## PMV influences much more than voice.

Research has demonstrated potential benefits related to:

- Communication
- Participation in medical care
- Restoration of airflow
- Improved cough
- Improved secretion management
- Improved smell and taste
- Potential improvements in swallowing
- Quality of life

---

## Key Takeaways

A successful PMV evaluation requires integration of:

- Respiratory physiology
- Airway anatomy
- Clinical reasoning
- Interdisciplinary collaboration
- Patient-centered care
